prompt.title: 待机 · 站立呼吸（idle）
prompt.rule: BREATHING ONLY. The whole clip is one slow breath in and out: the chest and the shoulders rise a little, hold, and settle back down, and the head dips very slightly with them. There are at most two breaths in the clip, and each one is slow and even.

MICRO MOTION. On top of the breath there is only a small sway of the upper body and a light drift of the loose parts of the clothes and hair, all of it under a few pixels. Nothing snaps, nothing bounces and nothing pops.

STILL FEET. Both feet stay exactly where they are, flat on the same spot of ground, for the whole clip. He does not step, does not shift his weight from one foot to the other, does not turn, does not look around and does not raise his arms.
CLOSES. The last frame is the same pose as the first frame, so the clip loops.
